digest.component_or_area: RP-04 S7.3 legacy ambient read elimination across reconciler, store, cli, llm, mcp subsystems
propositions: ~110+ direct ambient config/credential reads (os.getenv, os.environ, load_config) exist below approved composition seams across reconciler, store, snapshot, io, cli, commands, llm, mcp subsystems and must be eliminated or registered

Every below-seam ambient read, backend reload, and configurable adapter default must be cut to compose through the approved seam or registered with exact path+symbol+rationale and legit test-only rationale
Legacy exception set (slice C1) must reach EMPTY with no path-glob exceptions and all S1-S6 behavioral suites passing before legacy facades and migration switches are removed
Redacted operation snapshot fingerprints and provider-neutral outcomes must remain unchanged pre/post refactoring except for explicitly recorded and justified approved deltas
Live-resolved reads (e.g. push mode) must cut to a live-per-call resolver rather than compose-once; per-job ambient reloads and migration exceptions must be removed only after focused suites pass
